links.outcome: Clarity and understandability of LLM responses to AIS patient questions, rated by experts
links.effect: Only one-third of responses were rated sufficiently understandable, despite 91% factual accuracy for both models.
links.quote: However, clarity was limited, with only one-third of responses rated as sufficiently understandable.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of two commercial LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.5 and GPT 5.2) on 100 patient questions related to adolescent idiopathic scoliosis without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
